descriptive_audit.acf_max_lag_rule: minimum of 240 rows/120 seconds and longest-video rows minus 4; every lag records tapering eligible-video and pair support
descriptive_audit.pacf_max_lag_rule: minimum of 64 rows/32 seconds and the registered ACF maximum, with tapering support

target_derivation.primitive: one intact same-video future trajectory for each label/washout/horizon
target_derivation.event_view: training-owned quantile threshold applied to nonzero-washout maximum positive arousal movement
target_derivation.event_quantile_selection_rule: audit q0.50..q0.99; for each nonzero-washout maximum-positive-arousal geometry, require at least 20 event rows and events in at least 50% of videos in every grouped test fold, reject thresholds above that geometry's median training-fold relative threshold range, then retain up to six evenly spaced supported q0.80..q0.99 thresholds
target_derivation.geometry_rule: derive short/medium/long horizons and washouts from VEATIC ACF crossings, then require duration-panel support
target_derivation.minimum_geometry_support: at least 90% of videos with at least 10 eligible rows per video; shorter unsupported videos remain explicit
required_threshold_checks: event-video fraction per grouped test fold

split_derivation.blocked_semantics: all sufficiently supported videos; earlier/later eligible rows within each video
split_derivation.blocked_required_gate: nonempty strict-forward inner train, inner validation, and outer test with zero overlap in every participating video
split_derivation.selection_rule: maximize outer then inner training ownership subject to at least 30% outer test, at least 14% total inner validation, strict forward ownership for every geometry, and at least 20 whole test videos per grouped fold
event_target_selection_inputs: event rows and event-video coverage in each grouped fold

shared_computation.allowed: lossless trajectory primitive, identity, causal indices, identical split masks, and later transforms with identical training ownership
shared_computation.separate_specialists: event and continuous targets retain separate thresholds, AR, loss, head, checkpoint, metrics, and confirmation
shared_computation.combined_challenger: not eligible until both specialists pass independently; must beat each specialist on its own locked endpoint

supervised_combination_output.event_target_binding: each candidate binds nonzero washout, horizon, maximum-positive-arousal metric, and training-owned quantile
supervised_combination_output.continuous_target_binding: each candidate binds nonzero washout, horizon, maximum-positive-arousal metric, and train-owned simple-history residualization

executor_backtest.workload: all 124 real videos; allowlisted NPZ/CSV load, all label/audit distributions, and arousal ACF through 64 rows
executor_backtest.gpu_disposition: not applicable for CSV parsing, ZIP decompression, and small label statistics

outputs.publication: temporary sibling then atomic rename then read-only seal

execution.precondition: this registration and implementation commit is present on origin/main
execution.preflight: unit/integrity tests must pass; then load all 124 videos and execute one comprehensive run using every eligible row for every supported geometry in the full registered derivation set
